reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates pass. Migration L25 confirms `using(true)` SELECT policy on `attendance.users` for all authenticated users, directly exposing every user's `card_id`. `20260317000001_fix_security_permissions.sql:102` confirms EXECUTE on `attendance.record_attendance_by_card(text)` is granted to `anon`. An attacker can trigger this via an authenticated session by executing `SELECT supabase_auth_user_id, card_id FROM attendance.users` to harvest all card_ids, then calling the public RPC `attendance.record_attendance_by_card('<victim_card_id>')` as anon, causing arbitrary attendance records to be forged or suppressed for any user. Severity upgraded from Medium to High: card_id is the sole kiosk authentication credential and mass harvesting is trivially possible for any authenticated user, matching the explicitly flagged key security concern 'NFC card ID spoofing in attendance recording'.
